verdict.rationale: Pipedream's CLI offers `pd dev`, which links a local file to a deployed component and live-updates it on Pipedream as you save. Workflows can also be tested manually with "Send Test Event". However, `pd dev` covers event sources rather than workflows, execution stays in Pipedream's cloud, and the documented development/production environment split applies only to Connect, not the workflows product. missing for 10: local execution of workflows, a dedicated dev instance/environment for workflows, CI/headless test-run support, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run workflows locally or against a dev instance for development and CI testing

citations.quote: pd dev` allows you to interactively develop a source from a local file.`pd dev` will link your local file with the deployed component and watch your local file for changes.
When you save changes to your local file, your component will automatically be updated on Pipedream.
Then you can select a specific test event and manually trigger your workflow with that event data by clicking Send Test Event.
